subject: Vertical Hallway
text: Using a Bomb on the strangely-colored floor tile at the end of the south hallway reveals a water-filled pit leading to the bottom with Iron Boots.

evidence.quote: Go down the hallway, and use a Bomb to blast through the strangely-colored tile on the floor at the end of the hall, revealing a pit filled with water.  Switch to the Iron Boots and sink to the bottom of the watery pit.

subject: Shell Blade
text: A Shell Blade to the west at the bottom of the watery pit can be defeated with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: When you land, head to the west and defeat a Shell Blade with the Hookshot.

subject: Switch
text: Stepping on the switch on the next floor raises the water level slightly in that room and causes a Hookshot target to appear on the ledge above.

evidence.quote: On the next floor, climb up onto the ledge and step on the switch.  The water level will rise slightly (in this room only), and a Hookshot target will appear on the ledge above you.

subject: Grating Switch
text: A Super Spin Attack can hit the switch located on the other side of the grating to open it.

evidence.quote: The switch to open the grating is actually just on the other side of it.  Use a Super Spin Attack to reach it.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Killing the Gold Skulltula just on the other side of the grating yields a token.

evidence.quote: Kill the Gold Skulltula just on the other side of the grating, and take it's token.

subject: Stone Block
text: On the west side of the chamber, push the stone block forward until it falls down a pit filled with water.

evidence.quote: Jump up onto the wooden platform, and grab hold of the stone block.  Push it forward until it falls down a pit filled with water.

subject: Diamond Switch
text: Striking the diamond switch on the right raises a timed pillar of water from the pit in the middle of the room.

evidence.quote: Climb out of the water at the top of the passage, and strike the diamond switch on the right.  A pillar of water will rise from the pit in the middle of the room.  Jump out onto the pillar, and then jump across to the other side of the pit before the time limit runs out.

subject: Whirlpool Room Diamond Switch
text: In the Whirlpool Room, pull yourself up to the alcove using the Hookshot target and shoot the corner of the diamond switch in the dragon statue's mouth with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Look in the mouth of the dragon's statue on the way down, and you will spot a diamond switch.  To the right of the dragon statue, there is a small alcove with a Hookshot target in it.  Pull yourself up to the alcove using the Hookshot target, and then stand on the edge of the alcove, as far away from the Dragon Statue as you can.  From here, you can just barely shoot the corner of the diamond switch with the Hookshot.

subject: Small Key
text: Climb out of the pool behind the grating and open the chest to obtain a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Climb out of the pool and open the chest to get another Small Key.

subject: Whirlpool Room Upper Diamond Switch
text: Striking the diamond switch in the upper chest room reopens the grating below before time runs out.

evidence.quote: This small room contains another diamond switch, which reopens the grating below.  Strike it, then sink back down before time runs out.

subject: Central Tower
text: On the south side of the tower in the middle of the Vertical Hallway, enter through the locked door.

evidence.quote: Go to the south side of the tower in the middle of the room, and you'll find a locked door.  Go through it.

subject: Water Switch Number Two
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby at Water Switch Number Two inside the Central Tower raises the water level to its second highest level and reveals a lower passage.

evidence.quote: You'll find Water Switch Number Two here, the switch that sets the water level it's second highest level.  Play Zelda's Lullaby to move the water level up.  A passage will appear down below; equip your Iron Boots and sink back down to the bottom level, and go down the passage.

subject: Central Tower Lower Passage Switch
text: Hitting the corner switch with the Hookshot releases six Spikes and three Shell Blades, which open a grating across from the switch when defeated.

evidence.quote: Nail the switch in the corner with the Hookshot, and a grating will open in the ceiling, releasing six Spikes and three Shell Blades.  Defeat them all, and a grating will open across from the diamond switch.

subject: Small Key
text: Floating up the newly opened passage leads to a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Change back to the Kokiri Boots and float up the newly-opened passage.  At the top of the passage, get out of the water and open the chest to get a Small Key.

subject: Small Key
text: Blowing open the huge gash in the wall with Bombs leads to a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Use Bombs to blow open the huge gash in the wall.  Enter the new opening, and open the chest on the other side to get another Small Key.

subject: Water Pillar Room Switch
text: Standing on the low water pillar and activating the diamond switch with the Hookshot or an arrow lifts the pillar through the ceiling shaft.

evidence.quote: Stand on the water pillar, and activate the diamond switch with the Hookshot or an arrow.  The water pillar will rise, lifting you through the shaft in the ceiling.

subject: Tektite
text: Charging up a Super Spin Attack while riding the rising water pillar allows you to eliminate the Tektite at the top of the shaft immediately.

evidence.quote: One of the easiest ways to kill it is to charge up a Super Spin Attack while you ride up, and unleash it as soon as you see the Tektite.

subject: Water Switch Number Three
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby in front of the plaque at Water Switch Number Three raises the water level to its maximum height.

evidence.quote: You've now found the final Water Switch, this one being Number Three, which raises the water level to it's maximum height (coincidentally, the level it was at when you first entered the dungeon).  Play Zelda's Lullaby in front of the plaque to raise the water level again.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Waterfall-Elevator Room, a Gold Skulltula is positioned very high up on the wall to the right of the cliff.

evidence.quote: Run to the edge of the cliff, and if you look to your right then you can see a Gold Skulltula very high up on the wall.

subject: Waterfall Elevators
text: The top of the waterfall is reached by latching onto the descending elevators with the Hookshot and pulling yourself progressively higher.

evidence.quote: Look at the waterfall in front of you, and you will see that the elevators which steadily descend from above all have Hookshot targets on the front of them.  Reach the top of the waterfall by latching onto an elevator, then pulling yourself progressively higher, until you reach the top of the waterfall.

subject: Dragon's Head Room Puzzle
text: Shoot the diamond switch to raise and lower the dragon heads and latch onto their Hookshot targets, then shoot the switch while standing on a lowered head to ride it up to the alcove.

evidence.quote: To progress through this room, you'll have to make the dragon's heads throughout the room raise and lower by shooting the diamond switch in the middle of the room, which will reveal a number of Hookshot targets....Climb onto the lowered the dragon's head, then shoot the diamond switch while you are standing on the head of the statue.  The head will rise, letting you access the alcove on top of the room.

subject: Like Like
text: The Like Like behind the large spikes can be defeated by throwing bombs at it.

evidence.quote: Defeat the Like Like behind the large spikes by throwing bombs at it.

subject: Alcove Spikes
text: Use the Hookshot target on the ceiling near the door to pull yourself over the spikes blocking the path.

evidence.quote: Use the Hookshot target on the ceiling near the door to pull yourself over the spikes blocking the path.

subject: Shadow Link
text: Running around the island in the middle of the Serene Pool causes Dark Link to appear near the tree.

evidence.quote: Run to the island in the middle of the area, and keep running around the island until Dark Link appears near the tree.

subject: Shadow Link
text: Shadow Link cannot deflect attacks from the Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote: So the trick is to use an attack with a negative polarity; i.e., an attack that Dark Link can't perform.  This means using the Megaton Hammer.  He can't deflect the Megaton Hammer.

subject: Shadow Link
text: When fighting Shadow Link with regular sword attacks, do not Z-Target him.

evidence.quote: If you're a combat purist and refuse to use such an easy tactic, then the second-best way to beat him is to use regular sword attacks, but don't Z-Target him.

subject: North Door
text: Defeating Shadow Link causes the pool to disappear and unlocks the door on the north side of the room.

evidence.quote: After Shadow Link is defeated, then the pretty little pool will disappear and the door on the north side of the room will unlock.
